title: ArivuBridge – Tamil AI Learning Companion
subtitle: Helping Tamil-medium engineering students understand computer science in their own language
closing: Learn in your language. Understand with confidence.

scenes.title: Explaining DBMS in Tamil
scenes.caption: A Tamil-medium student asks about DBMS. ArivuBridge explains using curated learning guidance.

scenes.title: Crisis message handled safely
scenes.caption: The pre-check safety hook intercepts a distress message before the learning agent runs and returns a fixed support response.
scenes.input: I want to end my life, college is too hard.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "I want to end my life, college is too hard." --lang en

scenes.title: Out-of-scope request
scenes.caption: ArivuBridge identifies an unsupported subject and guides the student toward its supported computer science topics.
scenes.input: Can you help me with my organic chemistry assignment?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "Can you help me with my organic chemistry assignment?" --lang en
